environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running inventory-service pod in namespace 'logistics'. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with pg_audit enabled. Database connection routed through PgBouncer sidecar. The database user 'svc_inventory_grpc' is mapped to PostgreSQL role 'ro_inventory_analytics' via RDS IAM authentication with the following grant chain: ro_inventory_analytics inherits from pg_read_all_data (built-in predefined role providing SELECT on all tables). No explicit DML grants exist. The role was provisioned by Terraform module 'rds-iam-roles' v3.2.1 which enforces NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE and revokes PUBLIC schema write. PgBouncer transaction pooling mode with server_reset_query='DISCARD ALL'. Pod security context: readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, runAsNonRoot=true.
